race.comment: LADY OLENNA (3) returns from a lengthy break and can go on with it this time in. Raced without luck from the wide gate when sixth over 1280m at Muswellbrook in the H&NW Champs on March 8. Back with the two trials and can hold a forward position from the sticky gate. ZUMBO (4) has a host of gear changes first-up. Undefeated in two starts over this trip and has a sound fresh record. Can take a hand in the finish. MOVE SHE CAN (11) turned in an eye-catching run first-up when she produced sharp splits to run second over 1000m at Dubbo. Key jockey change and gets map favours. SNEAKY PEE CEE (2) tough win in the heavy going at Rosehill in this company. Place best from the wide gate. BOMBAY BOOM (10) lightly raced gelding resuming. Maps well from the draw and the booking of Tim Clark is a good lead.
